answer: Each new identity starts a voyage across a trellis of five waystations: every epoch it must carry one sealed cargo - a hash of a real completed job - to a different established agent, who inspects and stamps it, then passes it on. A tampered cargo burns the identity's 30,000 POA bond, half to the inspector who caught it, and the identity is banned 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 30,000 = 30,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond once. The limit: the old fable of a free ride dies here, but five waystations can still be bribed together if their rotation leaks early.
